title: France vs England – World Cup third-place playoff: Prediction, kickoff
facts: France and England were scheduled to play in the 2026 FIFA World Cup third-place playoff at Miami Stadium in Florida.
The third-place playoff match between France and England was scheduled for Saturday at 5:00 pm local time (21:00 GMT).
Spain defeated France in the semifinals of the 2026 World Cup.
Argentina defeated England in the semifinals of the 2026 World Cup.
The third-place playoff match marks Didier Deschamps' final match as head coach of France.
Didier Deschamps has served as the head coach of the France national football team for 14 years.
Didier Deschamps led France to victory at the 2018 World Cup.
Kylian Mbappe and Lionel Messi were tied with eight goals each in the 2026 World Cup Golden Boot race ahead of the match.
Lionel Messi led the tournament Golden Boot race with four assists compared to Kylian Mbappe's three assists.
Kylian Mbappe was one goal behind Lionel Messi for the all-time World Cup goal-scoring record of 21 goals.
The Opta supercomputer predicted France to win the third-place playoff within 90 minutes with a 50.7 percent probability.
England defeated France 2-0 in their 1966 World Cup match and 3-1 in 1982.
France defeated England 2-1 in the quarterfinals of the 2022 World Cup.
William Saliba was ruled out of the third-place playoff for France due to a back injury.
England's Jordan Henderson was unavailable for the third-place playoff due to a wrist injury.
